User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the SkillOrbit application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

email.description: User's email address. Null for anonymous users.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user account was created.

lastLogin.description: Timestamp indicating when the user last logged in.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Uses path-based ownership for private user data. All user data lives under this path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure authorization independence, clarity, and scalability for the SkillOrbit application.  Authorization Independence is achieved by limiting authorization to `request.auth.uid` only and storing roles in the database.  The structure promotes easy debugging through clear path-based ownership and consistent naming conventions.  The design uses structural segregation to ensure homogeneous security postures for collections.

Private user data is stored under `/users/{userId}`, enabling simple ownership-based security rules.  This design avoids the use of `get()` calls in security rules by ensuring that all necessary authorization data is available within the document or can be inferred from the path.

QAPs are addressed by ensuring each collection has a homogenous security posture. All documents within a collection have similar security needs. This simplifies security rules and avoids filtering data based on authorization within a single collection.
